Drop writes no text of a hidden element or a template

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("hidden_content" = "drop"), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
